objective: Fix critical state leakage and architectural flaws by implementing two new explicit tools for order management before the production launch.

tasks.title: Add Combo State Cleanup on Call End
details: In the `cleanup_call_data` function, add a call to `combo_order_manager.clear_order(call_sid)`.
This ensures state is cleared for every call to prevent leakage between sessions.
Add a log message to confirm that the cleanup operation was performed for the specific call.

tasks.title: Define New Tool Schemas
details: Add `FINALIZE_CURRENT_ITEM_TOOL_SCHEMA` for the `finalize_current_item` tool.
Add `PLACE_ORDER_TOOL_SCHEMA` for the `place_order` tool.

tasks.title: Implement `handle_finalize_current_item` Handler
details: Create the new handler function `handle_finalize_current_item`.
The logic must check if a combo item is active and finalize it, or check if a standard item is active and finalize it.
If no item is active, return an appropriate error message.
After finalizing, add the item to the cart using `order_manager.add_item_to_cart`.
Return the confirmation message: 'Added [item] to your order. Anything else?'

tasks.title: Implement `handle_place_order` Handler
details: Create the new handler function `handle_place_order`.
The logic must validate the cart is not empty, build the payload for the POS system, and submit the order.
On success, set a 'placed' flag to prevent duplicate orders, clear the cart, and return a final confirmation message.
On failure, log the error and return a user-friendly message, keeping the cart intact for a retry.

tasks.title: Register New Tools
details: Add `finalize_current_item` and `place_order` to the list of available tools for the AI agent.
Ensure the old `order_summary` tool is removed from the tool registration list.

tasks.title: Update System Prompt Logic
details: Remove the complex conditional logic related to `order_summary` with 'IN PROGRESS' vs 'DONE' statuses.
Define a clear, simple workflow for the agent using the new tools.
New Workflow: 1. `check_menu_item` -> 2. Configure item -> 3. `finalize_current_item` -> 4. (Loop for more items or...) -> 5. `place_order`.

tasks.title: Unit Test New Handlers
details: Write comprehensive unit tests for `handle_finalize_current_item` covering all logic paths.
Write comprehensive unit tests for `handle_place_order` covering success and failure cases.

tasks.title: Integration Test Full Flow
details: Create an end-to-end integration test that simulates a full user call for a combo order.
Replicate the exact scenario from `log.json` to confirm the state leakage and premature order bugs are fixed.
Test edge cases such as placing an order with an empty cart, ordering multiple items, and user changing their mind.

tasks.title: Remove `order_summary` Tool Completely
details: Delete the schema for `order_summary` from `app/handlers/common_tool_defs.py`.
Delete the handler function `handle_order_summary_thirty_nine_miles_en` from `app/handlers/english_tool_logic.py`.
Search the codebase for any remaining references to `order_summary` and remove them.

success_criteria: State does not leak between consecutive calls.
The AI agent correctly uses `finalize_current_item` and `place_order` at the appropriate times.
The error loop identified in `log.json` is no longer reproducible.
The system is robust, clear, and ready for production launch.
